facts.text: GGUF binary layout enforces 32-byte alignment for all tensor weight arrays, ensuring zero-copy vector instructions (NEON and AVX) execute without unaligned memory access penalties. (high confidence)

K-quants (Q4_K_M) partition weights into super-blocks of 256 weights containing sub-blocks with independent scales and offsets, preserving perplexity comparable to unquantized FP16 at a fraction of memory bandwidth. (high confidence)
